experiment.name: Severity definition map: definition components by independent unit, and markers tested against their own definition
experiment.description: How do canine babesiosis studies define severe disease, and how often is a marker tested against a definition that contains it? Descriptive; no hypothesis.
experiment.summary: 78 severity definitions in 42 independent units; the commonest component is death (20 units). A tested marker is part of its own definition in 38 of 504 tested rows (7.5%) and in 7 of 31 units; those rows are significant 79% of the time against 47% for other rows. 0 tests.

sections.heading: Question
paragraphs: How do canine babesiosis studies define severe disease, how many independent units use each component, and how often is a marker tested against a definition that contains it?

sections.heading: What was done
paragraphs: Every severity definition extracted by SV-G2 was listed with species, setting, outcome class and components. Components were counted by independent unit and species group. A tested row was flagged as circular when its marker belongs to a component of its definition (a fixed marker-to-component map in the spec), when the outcome class is defined by the marker (anaemia grade, parasitaemia level), or when the marker is named in the definition text.

sections.heading: Result
paragraphs: 78 definitions in 42 units; median 1 component per definition. Components by units: death 20, other 15, renal 14, anaemia grade 13, hepatic or icterus 11, cerebral 7.
Outcome classes by units: mortality 16, severity_grade 11, anaemia_grade 10, complicated 9, specific_complication 8, parasitaemia_level 3, treatment_intensity 3, other 2, organ_dysfunction 1.
Circularity: 38 of 504 tested rows (7.5%), in 7 of 31 units with tests. Circular rows are significant 79% of the time, other rows 47%.
Euthanasia in mortality definitions: not stated 6, yes 11, no 1.

sections.heading: What this does not show
paragraphs: Components are the extractors' coding of the authors' text; the marker-to-component map is a fixed rule and misses markers that enter a definition indirectly (for example through a clinical score). Species is aliased with source and setting, so component use by species is not a species difference.
